figures: 1. Figure 1: Overview of concept-choice leakage attack on concept-aware embedding sanitization. Left: SPARSE-style sanitization applies concept-specific anisotropic noise η ∼ Mahalanobis(ΣCk) to embeddings. Middle: Under multi-release access, an attacker observes multiple sanitized embeddings of the same document and computes their difference ∆, which cancels the original embedding and reveals noise statistics. Right: The attacker computes a variance fingerprint from ∆ ⊙ ∆ across documents and matches it to concept templates, achieving 100% concept identification accuracy.

2. Figure 2: Effect of covariance smoothing on concept-choice leakage. The attack maintains 100% accuracy for all smoothing parameters λ ≤ 0.95. Only at extreme smoothing (λ = 0.99, mixing 99% identity covariance) does accuracy drop to 63.3%, still well above the 30% mitigation threshold and 20% chance level. Error bars show standard deviation across 3 seeds.
